label: H3 Hybrid (H3 FL2VA with Ref2VA's reference layers)

retry._note: A render that asked for retries and whose takes kept failing their checks (takecheck) renders once more on `fallback`, from the failed take's first frame as its first keyframe (api's retry step): stock FL2VA, the weights the hybrid is mostly made of.

_note: A community merge of MiniMax H3's two official checkpoints (huggingface.co/smhfacct/Minimax-H3-fl2va-ref2va-hybrid-models; MiniMax H3's licence): FL2VA's weights everywhere but the per-block `adaln_proj` of blocks 25-49, which are Ref2VA's, so it reads Ref2VA's reference pictures with FL2VA's cleaner picture. Checked tensor by tensor against the two pruned INT8 files (2026-11-12): 681 tensors FL2VA's, 50 Ref2VA's (exactly those adaln_proj), 201 the same in both. It is Ref2VA's architecture in its slot, so everything but the weights is Ref2VA's: the node, the prompt and compile (compile.py), the text encoder, VAEs and the Ref2V turbo LoRAs. Why: Ref2VA with its 8-step turbo LoRA turns thin lines in a reference (a stethoscope, a phone cord, a lanyard) into a lattice over the picture, and a new seed doesn't help (docs/DAILIES.md). Tried live 2026-11-12 (Porchlights ep02, final pass, 8-step turbo, each shot's own seed): sh1460, sh1495, sh1590, sh1610 and sh290 clean where Ref2VA's takes had the lattice; sh140, sh170 and sh1620 as good as Ref2VA's. Holds a reference a little less tightly than Ref2VA (its card says so): on sh1470 it lost Denise's locs, and moved the lattice to a mesh over the whole frame. No default_rank: picked by name.

template._note: H3 renders 17k+5 frames, at most 3592; width and height must be multiples of 32.

continuous._note: docs/CONTINUOUS.md. `latent`: the previous take's last `overlap` frames (rounded up to 17j+5) held at the head of the render, video and audio, by H3ChainLatent between `sampler`'s `input` and its source; it reads the previous take's kept latent, else encodes its last frames through the VAEs. The held frames are trimmed off before the saver (H3ChainTrim). `continuous: first` needs a first keyframe, which Ref2VA doesn't read: such a shot builds on `first` (H3 FL2VA) instead, unless it names its own target.

multishot._note: H3's spec's timed sections: one prompt whose description has a [Shot N] section per shot of the group, every later one `At MM:SS.mmm, the shot cuts to ...` (docs/MULTISHOT.md; a three-shot proof cut within 3 frames of the asked times). One plate a generation: the group's first shot's.

recipe._note: Up to eight subjects (characters first, then props and vehicles, in script order): Pictures 1-3, then 5-9. Picture 4 is always the location plate, where it has always been, so a shot of three subjects or fewer sends just what it did. Sockets past the last subject stay empty. Each character is fed ONE panel of its 4-panel sheet: the face panel on a single-character close-up, the three-quarter body panel otherwise. Clone mode feeds one voice sample per speaker, at most 3.

retention._note: H3's audio retention markers, and the IR's neutral `preserve` mapped onto them. fully_copy makes a dub slice the whole soundtrack; partially_copy copies the voices and lets H3 add foley; reference only borrows timbre and timing.

size_hints.voice sample: 5-15 seconds of clean speech, mono wav

recipe._keyframes_note: A first frame only when the shot asks for one (continuous: first, a first: line): anchored at frame 0 by MiniMaxH3AddGuide after the reference node, its pictures kept (minimax_h3_ref2va/first_frame.py). Not asked for: rendered as Ref2VA always is.

models._note: The family each model param must be (targets/modelid.py). Names are checked first (case-insensitive globs; a series config's model_families adds more), then the file's header. Ref2VA and FL2VA share every tensor, so a file named neither is accepted as H3 with a note, and one named FL2VA is refused. Tiers (docs/API.md): the turbo LoRA is an accelerator (without it the pass renders its `base`); the rest are required. text_encoder / video_vae / audio_vae are the workflow's own files (`default`): patched only when another file of the family stands in. A substitute LoRA keeps the wanted one's step count (`keep`).

model._note: Its header is H3's and its name says both FL2VA and Ref2VA, so it is identified as H3 with a note (targets/modelid.py: a name matching both variants picks neither), never refused. Told apart from the stock files by name: every other H3 target's model pattern excludes *hybrid*.

presets._note: Turbo LoRA per pass. The final pass uses lightx2v's 8-step Ref2V v1.0, distilled at 768p for exactly 8 steps. The proxy keeps the 4-step v0.1: a distilled LoRA is trained on a fixed set of timesteps, so it does best at its own step count, and the proxy wants 4 steps for speed. The series config's `series` and `proxy` blocks override these. `base` is what a pass renders with when its turbo LoRA isn't installed: no LoRA, 20 steps with res_multistep (ComfyUI's H3 templates, video_minimax_h3_r2v.json / _i2v / _t2v, full branch: 'Int (Full)' 20, KSamplerSelect res_multistep, BasicScheduler simple) and no CFG, as those templates guide with BasicGuider and so does this workflow ('Guider (CFG 1)').

upscale._note: h3upscale.py: a final take re-sampled at `scale` from `start` (a fraction of its own schedule: 0.875 is step 7 of 8), its latent's video upscaled by `upscaler` (ComfyUI's own, or a node pack: its `fallback`). The loader's resolution_override carries the new size into the conditioning.

windows._note: A re-sample of a take longer than `seconds` (5.5: the 4.5-5.2 s shots fit one pass at 2688x1536, longer ones risk running out of memory) is sampled in windows (upscale.windowed): MultiDiffusion along time with pyramid weights over each overlap, so 1344x768 x2 (2688x1536) fits 32 GB. ComfyUI's own node counts real frames (`frames`: 17n+5, so 5.5 s is 124 and 1.25 s is 39) and FreeNoise stays off, as the A/B against obvpm's ran it. `fallback`: obvpm's H3 Context Windowing, for a ComfyUI before 0.44 or asked for by the recipe's `windowing`. The series' upscale recipe's `window` overrides the length (0: off).

upscaler._note: ComfyUI's own (0.44 or later), loading the same model file as LBH-123-AI's pack. `fallback`: that pack, or its Plus, which register the same node, for an older ComfyUI or asked for by the recipe's `upscaler`.

downloads._note: Where to get each file this target names (docs/API.md 'Downloads'). A url is only given when a trustworthy record has it: a ComfyUI template's or saved workflow's properties.models entry, or ComfyUI-Manager's model list; `source` says which. Otherwise url is null and source says what to search for. Never a guessed URL.
